provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: for k=1:length(station) (L52) uses length() of a matrix, which is max(rows,cols); correct only while the station count exceeds 2 columns.
audit_member_text: Station-loop range defect: length(station) at L52 uses the largest matrix dimension, not the number of station rows. A one-row, two-column station file therefore iterates twice and indexes past sta_i/sta_j at L53-L55.

base_member_text: Label y-position uses Y(sta_j(k)-15,sta_i(k)) (L55) — an index offset of 15 rows — which errors if sta_j(k)<=15; also mixing an index offset (rows) with the -20 coordinate offset in x is inconsistent.
audit_member_text: Unchecked label offset: station markers use row sta_j(k), but label y coordinates use sta_j(k)-15 at L55. Any station with sta_j<=15 produces a zero/negative MATLAB index; no bounds check exists.

base_member_text: Station labels are generated as G<14-k> (L54), i.e. G13, G12, ... for k=1,2,...; this presumes exactly 13 stations ordered opposite to the FRF gauge numbering — the actual number of rows in station.txt is not visible here, and if it is not 13 labels go wrong (G0, negative).
Stale comments 'make up breaker and foam for visualization' and 'eta without breaker' (L42, L45) are leftovers from the sibling movie script and do not describe this code.
The +220 y-registration matches movie_eta_foam.m but differs from movie_mean_values.m (+180); which is correct for frf_03.jpg is not determinable here.

audit_member_text: Station indices are used directly against 800-by-660 X/Y without integer/range validation (L11-L13, L53-L55).
The dep binary read assumes exactly m*n singles and does not check fopen/fread success (L16-L19).
